subject: Request: Extended pilot & credit for MedicaLogic - security delay
messages:
From: Anna Zhao <anna@medicalogic.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pilot extension & credits due to security review delay

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the intro and the sandbox access — the initial integration went well. We're at the tail end of the internal security assessment but the audit raised two privacy controls that will require an extra validation cycle. That pushes our timeline out and jeopardizes the current 30-day pilot runway.

Can Redwood consider a one-off extension and some complimentary credits to cover the extended evaluation? To be concrete: we would need ~60-90 additional days and ~$10k in credits to run additional end-to-end tests (on redacted PHI). Our procurement team is asking for written authorization (email OK) so they can align internal approvals.

I've attached the security questionnaire excerpt the auditor flagged. Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Anna Zhao
Head of Engineering, MedicaLogic
anna@medicalogic.com
Attachments: SecurityRequest.pdf
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Zhao <anna@medicalogic.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot extension & credits due to security review delay

Marcus / Lauren — looping you in. MedicaLogic is asking for a 60-90 day runway extension and ~$10k in credits because a security audit added testing requirements. They are an HCO prospect (tested redacted PHI).

Quick context: they signed up via PLG, have low initial usage but growing technical interest; this is a strategic mid-market opportunity (internal champion Anna). Procurement needs a written ok to proceed.

Ask: can Deal Desk/Exec sign off on a one-time concession? Marcus, would you recommend a concession amount and conditions? Lauren, any legal must-haves for a limited extension for regulated data? Neha, heads-up for CS handoff and onboarding support if we get approval.

I can host a 15-min sync if helpful.

— Ethan
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwoodinference.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot extension & credits due to security review delay

Aditya — requesting one-off executive approval for MedicaLogic (DL-9842). See background from Ethan and Anna below.

Recommendation (Deal Desk):
- Approve a 75-day extension to the pilot (one-time only).
- Grant up to $8,000 in complimentary credits applied to their sandbox account.
- Conditions: procurement must submit PO for any paid conversion; CS will run a restricted test plan; Legal to sign a short addendum limiting scope of access and clarifying data handling (no new SLA, audit logs retained for 90 days).

Rationale:
- They are a regulated buyer in healthcare with clear interest in deployment.
- The ask is time-bound and tied to a security remediation; a modest credit/incentive materially increases probability of conversion.
- $8k is a measured midpoint between PLG limits (standard free credits exhausted) and the $10k ask.

I've attached a draft MOU that documents the extension and the limited scope we discussed. If Aditya approves, we will: 1) send a written approval to Anna (procurement), 2) attach the MOU, and 3) schedule a CS onboarding session.

Attachments: proposed-MOU.pdf

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Zhao <anna@medicalogic.com>, procurement@medicalogic.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot extension & credits due to security review delay

Thanks for the clear ask and the draft MOU. I'm approving a one-time, conditional concession as follows:

- Extension: 75 days added to the current pilot start/end dates.
- Credits: one-time grant of $8,000 in sandbox credits, applied immediately upon receipt of procurement acknowledgement email.
- Conditions:
  1) MedicaLogic signs the attached short addendum (Marcus's MOU) confirming scope and data handling limitations.
  2) Procurement provides an acknowledgement email/PO that they understand this is a limited evaluation concession and not a commitment to purchase.
  3) Security signoff: Lauren, please confirm that the addendum language addresses the auditor's items, or suggest final edits.

Operational notes: Ethan / Neha — please ensure this is documented on the HubSpot deal (DL-9842) and route account for a technical onboarding session with CS once the addendum is returned. Marcus — please send the approval to Anna with the MOU and copy procurement.

I'll mark this as approved in the Deal Desk tracker. One-off authority granted; anything beyond $8k or beyond 75 days requires CFO-level approval.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
